app_info.author: Codex
app_info.description: EMDMP external AI gateway for recommendation and business report generation

endpoints.title: Competitor Analysis
endpoints.description: Generate a structured competitor analysis using the cloud LLM with fallback output

endpoints.title: Start Competitor Analysis
endpoints.description: Start an asynchronous competitor analysis enhancement task

endpoints.title: Get Competitor Analysis Task Status
endpoints.description: Poll the current status of an asynchronous competitor analysis task

endpoints.title: Generate Marketing Copy
endpoints.description: Generate structured marketing copy for selected recommendation items

endpoints.title: Product QA Chat
endpoints.description: Answer product questions with structured item knowledge and conversation context

endpoints.title: Product QA Hot Questions
endpoints.description: Return suggested hot questions for the current product context

endpoints.title: Recommend Items
endpoints.description: Score candidate items with local LLM assistance

endpoints.title: Generate Business Report
endpoints.description: Generate a structured business report using the local LLM

endpoints.title: Generate Business Report PDF
endpoints.description: Generate a structured business report and export it to PDF

endpoints.title: Start Generate Business Report
endpoints.description: Start an asynchronous business report enhancement task

endpoints.title: Get Business Report Task Status
endpoints.description: Poll the current status of an asynchronous business report task

endpoints.title: Sales Forecast Predict
endpoints.description: Run the dedicated sales forecast Python model with feature snapshot input

endpoints.title: Generate User Behavior Diagnosis
endpoints.description: Generate a structured item or merchant behavior diagnosis using the cloud LLM with fallback output

endpoints.title: Start Generate User Behavior Diagnosis

endpoints.title: Get User Behavior Diagnosis Task Status
endpoints.description: Poll the current status of an asynchronous user behavior diagnosis task
